cohort: Audited 17-credit-fund cohort only. All three original profiles; fresh 50 seeds each. Not pooled with previous confirmation.
design: Identical E3 standardized per-asset L1 adapter and independent validation selector, targets zero, same-training Rates+Credit OLS, same-training Equity+Rates+Credit OLS. All other target coordinates zero. Uniform weights and intercept. No added independent economic information.
motivation: Frozen after the original two-factor target underperformed, to test the previously recorded omitted-Equity explanation. Follow-up sensitivity, not original confirmatory hypothesis. No selection of favorable profiles.
metrics: Credit MSE, 9-factor isolated one-SD scenario MSE/response variance, test MSE/response variance. Aggregate 17 assets per seed then paired Monte Carlo intervals. No covariance or oracle claim.
validation: 9 package-objective comparisons on separate seed979999, independent centred versus intercept restricted regressions, exact row counts, direct credit-error reconstruction, corrupt/missing rows rejected.
